changes.name: MeteorGameServer
changes.source:
local Players=game:GetService("Players")
local TweenService=game:GetService("TweenService")

-- CLEAN BUILD 1: Mine the Meteor
local old=workspace:FindFirstChild("MeteorGame")
if old then old:Destroy() end

local gameFolder=Instance.new("Folder")
gameFolder.Name="MeteorGame"
gameFolder.Parent=workspace

local map=Instance.new("Part")
map.Name="Ground"
map.Size=Vector3.new(150,4,150)
map.Position=Vector3.new(0,0,0)
map.Anchored=true
map.Material=Enum.Material.Slate
map.Color=Color3.fromRGB(45,48,55)
map.Parent=gameFolder

local spawn=Instance.new("SpawnLocation")
spawn.Name="Spawn"
spawn.Size=Vector3.new(12,1,12)
spawn.Position=Vector3.new(0,3,55)
spawn.Anchored=true
spawn.Neutral=true
spawn.Material=Enum.Material.Neon
spawn.Color=Color3.fromRGB(80,180,255)
spawn.Parent=gameFolder

local crater=Instance.new("Part")
crater.Name="Crater"
crater.Shape=Enum.PartType.Cylinder
crater.Size=Vector3.new(2,44,44)
crater.Orientation=Vector3.new(0,0,90)
crater.Position=Vector3.new(0,2,0)
crater.Anchored=true
crater.CanCollide=false
crater.Material=Enum.Material.Basalt
crater.Color=Color3.fromRGB(25,25,30)
crater.Parent=gameFolder

local meteor
local meteorHP=0
local MAX_HP=100
local cycle=0
local miningEnabled=false

local function makeMeteor()
 cycle+=1
 miningEnabled=false
 if meteor then meteor:Destroy() end
 meteor=Instance.new("Part")
 meteor.Name="Meteor"
 meteor.Shape=Enum.PartType.Ball
 meteor.Size=Vector3.new(24,24,24)
 meteor.Position=Vector3.new(0,75,0)
 meteor.Anchored=true
 meteor.Material=Enum.Material.Rock
 meteor.Color=Color3.fromRGB(88,66,58)
 meteor.Parent=gameFolder
 meteor:SetAttribute("Health",MAX_HP)
 meteor:SetAttribute("MaxHealth",MAX_HP)
 meteorHP=MAX_HP

 local fire=Instance.new("PointLight")
 fire.Color=Color3.fromRGB(255,120,45)
 fire.Brightness=4
 fire.Range=35
 fire.Parent=meteor

 TweenService:Create(meteor,TweenInfo.new(1.3,Enum.EasingStyle.Quad,Enum.EasingDirection.In),{Position=Vector3.new(0,13,0)}):Play()
 task.wait(1.35)
 miningEnabled=true
end

local function breakMeteor()
 if not miningEnabled then return end
 miningEnabled=false
 meteorHP=0
 if meteor then
  meteor:SetAttribute("Health",0)
  local boom=TweenService:Create(meteor,TweenInfo.new(.35,Enum.EasingStyle.Back,Enum.EasingDirection.In),{Size=Vector3.new(2,2,2),Transparency=1})
  boom:Play()
  boom.Completed:Wait()
  meteor:Destroy()
  meteor=nil
 end
 task.wait(3)
 makeMeteor()
end

local function mine(player)
 if not miningEnabled or not meteor or meteorHP<=0 then return end
 local char=player.Character
 local root=char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
 if not root or (root.Position-meteor.Position).Magnitude>24 then return end

 local power=1
 meteorHP=math.max(0,meteorHP-power)
 meteor:SetAttribute("Health",meteorHP)

 local stats=player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
 local gems=stats and stats:FindFirstChild("Gems")
 if gems then gems.Value+=1 end

 local original=meteor.Size
 meteor.Size=original*0.97
 task.delay(.08,function()
  if meteor and meteor.Parent then meteor.Size=original end
 end)

 if meteorHP<=0 then
  for _,p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
   local g=p:FindFirstChild("leaderstats") and p.leaderstats:FindFirstChild("Gems")
   if g then g.Value+=25 end
  end
  task.spawn(breakMeteor)
 end
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
 local stats=Instance.new("Folder");stats.Name="leaderstats";stats.Parent=player
 local gems=Instance.new("IntValue");gems.Name="Gems";gems.Value=0;gems.Parent=stats
end)
for _,player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
 if not player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats") then
  local stats=Instance.new("Folder");stats.Name="leaderstats";stats.Parent=player
  local gems=Instance.new("IntValue");gems.Name="Gems";gems.Value=0;gems.Parent=stats
 end
end

local mineEvent=Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
mineEvent.Name="MineMeteor"
mineEvent.Parent=game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
mineEvent.OnServerEvent:Connect(mine)

task.spawn(makeMeteor)
print("Mine the Meteor Build 1 loaded")

changes.name: MeteorGameClient
changes.source:
local Players=game:GetService("Players")
local RS=game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local player=Players.LocalPlayer
local event=RS:WaitForChild("MineMeteor")

local gui=Instance.new("ScreenGui")
gui.Name="MeteorUI";gui.ResetOnSpawn=false;gui.Parent=player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

local gems=Instance.new("TextLabel")
gems.Position=UDim2.new(0,18,0,18);gems.Size=UDim2.new(0,220,0,55)
gems.BackgroundColor3=Color3.fromRGB(25,28,35);gems.BackgroundTransparency=.12
gems.TextColor3=Color3.new(1,1,1);gems.Font=Enum.Font.GothamBold;gems.TextSize=24
gems.Parent=gui
Instance.new("UICorner",gems).CornerRadius=UDim.new(0,12)

local hp=Instance.new("TextLabel")
hp.AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(.5,0);hp.Position=UDim2.new(.5,0,0,20);hp.Size=UDim2.new(0,360,0,48)
hp.BackgroundColor3=Color3.fromRGB(25,28,35);hp.BackgroundTransparency=.12
hp.TextColor3=Color3.fromRGB(255,190,95);hp.Font=Enum.Font.GothamBold;hp.TextSize=22;hp.Parent=gui
Instance.new("UICorner",hp).CornerRadius=UDim.new(0,12)

local hint=Instance.new("TextLabel")
hint.AnchorPoint=Vector2.new(.5,1);hint.Position=UDim2.new(.5,0,1,-35);hint.Size=UDim2.new(0,420,0,44)
hint.BackgroundTransparency=1;hint.Text="Get close to the meteor and CLICK to mine!"
hint.TextColor3=Color3.new(1,1,1);hint.TextStrokeTransparency=.35;hint.Font=Enum.Font.GothamBold;hint.TextSize=20;hint.Parent=gui

local gemValue=player:WaitForChild("leaderstats"):WaitForChild("Gems")
local function updateGems() gems.Text="💎 GEMS  "..gemValue.Value end
gemValue:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Value"):Connect(updateGems);updateGems()

local meteor
local healthConn
local function hookMeteor(m)
 meteor=m
 if healthConn then healthConn:Disconnect() end
 local function update()
  if m.Parent then hp.Text="☄ METEOR  "..tostring(m:GetAttribute("Health") or 0).." / "..tostring(m:GetAttribute("MaxHealth") or 100) end
 end
 healthConn=m:GetAttributeChangedSignal("Health"):Connect(update);update()
end
local folder=workspace:WaitForChild("MeteorGame")
if folder:FindFirstChild("Meteor") then hookMeteor(folder.Meteor) end
folder.ChildAdded:Connect(function(v) if v.Name=="Meteor" then hookMeteor(v) end end)

player:GetMouse().Button1Down:Connect(function()
 if meteor and meteor.Parent then event:FireServer() end
end)
